segments.text: We first tried Digital marketing tools in 207. At the time, customer demand mattered because we wanted to stop stock-outs during festive seasons.
The biggest issue was Access to finance. Without steady power in Lagos, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Digital marketing tools—we saw Cost reduction within 8 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Staff training.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during Back-to-school.
